clause_text: Each party agrees to keep confidential all information disclosed by the other party and shall not disclose such information to any third party without prior written consent.
The receiving party shall maintain the confidentiality of all proprietary information and shall use such information solely for the purposes outlined in this Agreement.
All confidential information shared under this agreement shall be protected using reasonable security measures and shall not be used for any competitive purpose.
Both parties acknowledge that any breach of confidentiality obligations may cause irreparable harm, entitling the disclosing party to seek equitable relief.
The confidentiality obligations set forth herein shall survive the termination of this Agreement for a period of five (5) years.
Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing thirty (30) days written notice to the other party.
This Agreement shall terminate immediately upon written notice if the other party commits a material breach and fails to cure such breach within fifteen (15) days of notice.
Upon termination of this Agreement, all rights and licenses granted hereunder shall cease, and each party shall return or destroy all confidential materials.
The Company reserves the right to terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days prior written notice without liability to the other party.
Termination of this Agreement shall not affect any rights or obligations that have accrued prior to the effective date of termination.
Each party shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other party from any claims, damages, or liabilities arising out of its breach of this Agreement.
The Service Provider agrees to indemnify the Client against all third-party claims arising from the Service Provider's negligence or willful misconduct.
Indemnification obligations shall include reasonable attorney's fees and court costs incurred in connection with any covered claim.
The indemnified party shall promptly notify the indemnifying party of any claim for which indemnification is sought and shall cooperate fully in its defense.
Neither party's indemnification obligations shall apply to claims arising from the other party's gross negligence or intentional wrongdoing.
Payment of all invoices shall be due within thirty (30) days of the invoice date unless otherwise agreed in writing by the parties.
All amounts payable under this Agreement shall be in United States Dollars and shall be subject to applicable taxes.
Late payments shall accrue interest at the rate of one and one-half percent (1.5%) per month or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is lower.
The Client shall reimburse the Service Provider for all pre-approved expenses incurred in connection with the services rendered under this Agreement.
In the event of a payment dispute, the undisputed portion of any invoice shall remain due and payable on the original due date.
In no event shall either party be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising out of or related to this Agreement.
The total liability of either party under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
Each party's liability for direct damages shall be limited to the amount paid or payable under this Agreement in the three (3) months prior to the claim.
Neither party shall be liable for any loss of profits, loss of data, or business interruption arising from the performance or non-performance of this Agreement.
The limitations of liability set forth in this Agreement shall apply regardless of the form of action, whether in contract, tort, or otherwise.
All intellectual property rights in the work product created by the Service Provider under this Agreement shall vest exclusively in the Client upon full payment.
Each party retains ownership of its pre-existing intellectual property and grants the other party a limited license to use such IP solely for the purposes of this Agreement.
The Service Provider hereby assigns to the Client all right, title, and interest in any inventions, discoveries, or works created in the performance of the services.
Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as granting any rights to use the other party's trademarks, service marks, or trade names without prior written consent.
Any improvements or modifications to the Client's intellectual property made by the Service Provider shall be owned exclusively by the Client.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.
Any disputes arising under this Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the federal and state courts located in New York, New York.
The parties agree that any controversy or claim arising out of this Agreement shall be settled by binding arbitration in accordance with the AAA Commercial Arbitration Rules.
This Agreement shall be interpreted and enforced in accordance with the laws of England and Wales, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the English courts.
In the event of any conflict between the governing law provisions and local mandatory law, the local mandatory law shall prevail to the extent required by law.
The parties shall comply with all applicable data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and any national implementing legislation.
Personal data processed under this Agreement shall be used only for the purposes specified herein and shall not be sold or disclosed to unauthorized third parties.
The data processor shall implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure the security of personal data against unauthorized access or disclosure.
In the event of a data breach, the responsible party shall notify the affected party within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware of the breach.
Upon termination of the data processing activities, all personal data shall be securely deleted or returned to the data controller, as instructed in writing.
The receiving party shall limit disclosure of confidential information to its employees and agents who have a need to know for the purposes of this Agreement.
Any breach of this Agreement by either party shall entitle the non-breaching party to terminate this Agreement with immediate effect upon written notice.
The Service Provider shall indemnify the Client for any losses arising from the Service Provider's failure to comply with applicable laws and regulations.
All fees and charges under this Agreement are exclusive of applicable value-added tax, which shall be added at the prevailing rate.
Nothing in this Agreement shall exclude or limit either party's liability for death or personal injury caused by that party's negligence.
The Client shall own all moral rights in any works created by the Service Provider, to the extent permitted under applicable law.
The parties agree to attempt to resolve any dispute amicably through good-faith negotiations before resorting to arbitration or litigation.
Each party shall appoint a data protection officer where required by applicable law and shall cooperate with supervisory authorities as necessary.
The obligations of confidentiality shall not apply to information that is independently developed by the receiving party without use of the disclosing party's information.
The Service Provider shall maintain adequate insurance coverage, including professional indemnity insurance, throughout the term of this Agreement.
